audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows gave Jax the level at 2/10 while whys[0] through whys[5] all read 'Illaoi-favoured', and Illaoi wins 55.11% over 1635 games. Difficulty read 8.5/10 with a red tone and 'Hard matchup'.
audit.why: The chart contradicted the prose printed under it, the packet chart, and the win rate.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-5 set to Illaoi with ratings to match, 2+ items left with Jax at 3/10, as one atomic group across both layers; diffRating, tone, difficulty line, rating line and chart blurb brought into agreement.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldown numbers anywhere despite Counter Strike being the whole matchup.
audit.why: Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 — an enormous laning window — dropping to 9s at rank 5. Leap Strike is 8s, Grandmaster-at-Arms 110s.
audit.corrected: The 17s figure now drives the cooldown block, the do's and the win condition, with Leap Strike's 8s and the ultimate's 110s alongside.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single best interaction was absent: Leap of Faith grounds, which shuts off Leap Strike (Q) and Empower (W) — Jax's only mobility. The page instead said 'build armor, E him grounded', which does not describe anything in either kit.
audit.why: Grounding a champion whose escape is his engage means a committed Jax cannot leave the tentacle field for the ultimate's duration.
audit.corrected: Written into tldr, winCon, report[1], report[5] and the cooldown block.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1] wrote 'Counter Strikes' (packet suspectNames flagged it).

edits.after: Bait Counter Strike, then commit — your R grounds his Leap Strike escape.

edits.before: - Jax Counter Strike: matchup-defining — Dodges autos/slams + stuns. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Counter Strike (E): 17s at rank 1 — a huge window; bait it and you own the next 17 seconds. - Leap Strike (Q): 8s, and Leap of Faith grounds it. - Harsh Lesson (W): flat 4s. - Grandmaster-at-Arms: 110s.

edits.before: Dodges autos/slams + stuns. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Counter Strike is 17s at rank 1 — bait it, then you own the window.

edits.before: Track Jax's Counter Strike: Dodges autos/slams + stuns. Bait it. When it is down — Slam him in your field.
edits.after: Counter Strike dodges basic attacks and stuns, 17s at rank 1. Leap of Faith grounds his Leap Strike.

edits.before: His early — survive to your spikes. See the level-by-level chart for the swing points.
edits.after: Yours until two items — the chart below shows where his item scaling takes over.

edits.before: Overall difficulty: 8.5/10. The lane is decided by how well you track Counter Strike and how disciplined your pattern is.
edits.after: Overall difficulty: 4/10. The lane is decided by baiting Counter Strike and closing before his second item.

edits.before: Hard matchup — difficulty 8.5/10, Jax carry threat 10/10.
edits.after: Favoured matchup — difficulty 4/10, Jax carry threat 10/10.

edits.before: R Leap of Faith on a committed Jax spawns a tentacle ring; even if he E Counter Strikes the autos, your slams keep landing and he can't dodge the whole field.
edits.after: R Leap of Faith on a committed Jax spawns a tentacle ring and grounds him, so Counter Strike buys him one dodge window and no way to leave the field afterwards.

notes: Chart was inverted: six rows read Jax at 2/10 under whys that all said 'Illaoi-favoured', on a 55.11% lane. Substantive addition: Leap of Faith grounds Leap Strike and Empower, so ulting a committed Jax removes his exit — the page previously said 'E him grounded', which describes nothing in either kit. Counter Strike's 17s rank-1 cooldown is the concrete window and now drives the advice. UNVERIFIED, left as written: the page claims tentacle slams still land through Counter Strike. Riot's text says he dodges 'all incoming attacks', which is not clearly decidable from the kit file for tentacle damage; nothing was strengthened on the strength of it.
